acceptance: An adopting build whose only added .go files are the archived ancestor predicates reports 0 added comment lines (red today)

consumed.resolution: commentaudit's added-comment rule (AddedAcrossDiff and check, which the build floor, the commit gate and the CLI share) now skips everything under docs/, which holds records, not compiled code; the removed-history rule still reads docs/. Pinned end to end by TestCommentFloorFailures_AnAdoptedAncestorsArchivedPredicatesAddNoComment, which drives explanationdocs.ArchiveSupersededPredicatePackages then the floor under enforce (ADR-0115).

fix: Export the archive root from explanationdocs as its single spelling and exclude it from the comment floor's path set (and any other added-file scanner that is not module-scoped).
source: console, 2026-09-30 architecture review of the A2 fix (MEDIUM-3)
summary: Since continuation adoption archives the ancestor's own go/acs/cycle<M> under docs/private/research/archived-<date>/superseded-predicate-packages/ (design A2, 2026-09-30), those .go files are added paths in the adopting cycle's diff. commentaudit's added-comment scan filters by the .go suffix only, so every comment in the archived predicates counts as 'the build adds N comment line(s)'. Not a regression (the same lines counted at go/acs/cycle<M> before) and the floor is in shadow, but under comment_floor.stage=enforce it would force the builder to edit the archive, the same dead end cycle 1764 hit.
title: The build comment floor counts archived superseded predicate files as the build's new comments
